schemaEvidence: client-methods.json contains turn/interrupt and thread/resume; no pause or checkpoint method
limitation: The public RPC surface has no admission gate before the next autonomous model/tool call. Observing a notification and racing turn/interrupt cannot prove that no subsequent side effect has begun. thread/resume only reconnects native context and is not a checkpoint or effect proof.
nextWork: W3 must add and pin a narrow upstream boundary-admission and durable-consumption hook, then pass model/tool/compaction/queue boundary and crash-window tests. This W2 host advertises strict pause and resume as GAP and rejects their commands.
